title: Macro Scenario Updating System
text:
Quarto research dashboard



This project is a post-close research system, not a high-frequency trading engine. It updates scenario probabilities and covariance-path beliefs after the market close, then carries the posterior state forward as tomorrow’s prior. The system is designed to study how narrative expectations, war or policy shocks, realized reactions, and unexplained gaps evolve across daily, weekly, and monthly horizons.


Back to homepage GitHub profile

title: Macro Scenario Updating System
text:
Operating Objective



Research question


How does the market revise belief paths?
The system tracks how prior narratives, new shocks, realized reactions, and ex-post stories interact through time rather than trying to predict a single path ex ante.




State variables


Scenario state + covariance belief state
Each day stores both the scenario distribution and the evolving belief over expected volatility and correlation structure under the current narrative state.




Verification


Reaction is the referee
LLM interpretation is used for structured shock extraction and ex-post review. The model still verifies the narrative against realized market reaction and covariance-path fit.




Forecasting


Multi-horizon forecast leaves
Tomorrow, next-week, and next-month leaves are built from the updated posterior, unresolved gaps, and covariance-path state, then tested against realized outcomes.

title: Macro Scenario Updating System
text:
Core Update Logic
The scenario state update is score-based:
\[
\text{Score}_t(s)
=
\lambda_1 \log(P_{t-1}(s)+\epsilon)
+
\lambda_2 U_t(s)
+
\lambda_3 F_t(s)
\]
\[
P_t(s)=\frac{\exp(\text{Score}_t(s))}{\sum_j \exp(\text{Score}_t(j))}
\]
where:

(P_{t-1}(s)) is yesterday’s posterior carried into today
(U_t(s)) is the structured shock / expectation support score
(F_t(s)) is the reaction-fit score from realized market moves

The covariance belief state is kept in interpretable pieces rather than an unconstrained inverse-Wishart setup:
\[
\Sigma_t = D_t \rho_t D_t
\]
where (D_t) is the prior or posterior volatility scale and (_t) is the prior or posterior correlation matrix. The research object is the evolving path of ((D_t, _t)) from the episode start date to the current date.

title: Macro Scenario Updating System
text:
Layer Design




Prior state



Carry-forward from yesterday
Yesterday’s posterior scenario probabilities, posterior covariance belief, entropy, and unresolved gaps become today’s starting point.
:::



Structured shock layer



LLM-assisted event interpretation
After the close, the day’s information flow is summarized into a structured event ledger and shock vector instead of leaving the interpretation as free-form commentary.
:::



Reaction layer



Observed cross-asset move
The realized reaction vector covers rates, curve, breakeven, credit, USD, equities, oil, and volatility. Reaction fit is measured against scenario templates and covariance beliefs.
:::



Ex-post review



Story and puzzle diagnostics
The system records reaction gap, story-model gap, entropy, explained share, unexplained share, and gap decay. The disagreement between structural updater and ex-post story is a core research object.
:::
:::


Public-Data Scope


Scope note

This project does not claim Bloomberg-style high-frequency market microstructure identification. The core system is post-close and uses daily, weekly, and monthly updates. Optional sidecar work can use public ETF and futures proxies to study relative event-window speed, but the main research object is the evolving posterior over scenario paths and covariance paths from the episode start date forward.



Episode Frame



Baseline window


Pre-episode conditioning
Use a pre-war or pre-stress window to estimate baseline volatility and correlation structure before the episode begins.




Episode start


Anchor date
From the episode start date onward, the posterior path evolves recursively. Each day’s posterior becomes the next trading day’s prior.




Current snapshot


Today in context
At any current date, the dashboard shows both the full episode path through today and the posterior snapshot that seeds tomorrow’s update.




Multi-horizon memory


Daily / weekly / monthly
Path summaries are aggregated separately for each horizon so gap persistence, convergence, and regime transition can be studied at different timescales.

title: Jaeseok Hwang
text:
Bio / Profile


Macro research, public-data systems, and interpretable market state updating.


I am Jaeseok Hwang, a Ph.D. candidate in Applied Economics at UIUC. My current work focuses on building a research-grade rates and cross-asset scenario updating system that separates prior expectation, new shock, realized reaction, covariance-path belief, and ex-post story review.


Open research dashboard GitHub LinkedIn




Current role


Applied Economics Ph.D. candidate


Research focus: macro-finance interpretation, Bayesian updating, interpretable state tracking, and decision systems built from public data.




Current build


Daily macro scenario updating system


U.S. Treasury and cross-asset research stack with scenario memory, covariance-path beliefs, post-close review, and multi-horizon forecast leaves.




Working style


Research + implementation


I build the theory, the data pipeline, the update logic, the diagnostics, and the publishing layer together so the research can be inspected end to end.




Output format


Public daily research log


The website is being rebuilt as a post-close research notebook with daily updates, weekly reviews, methods notes, and project diagrams.






Dashboard Preview


Treasury / cross-asset scenario dashboard


This panel is the homepage view of the current research system. The full Quarto page holds the full process logic, operating cycle, and research framing.


Daily post-close update Weekly narrative review Monthly regime tracking




State update


Prior → shock → reaction → posterior


Yesterday’s posterior becomes today’s prior. After the close, structured shock interpretation and realized market reaction update the scenario state.




Covariance path


Belief over co-movement


The system tracks expected volatility and correlation paths across rates, breakeven, credit, USD, equities, oil, and volatility.




Gap diagnostics


What the prior missed


Reaction gap, story-model gap, entropy, explained share, and gap decay are stored as first-class objects rather than side metrics.




Forecast layer


Daily / weekly / monthly leaves


Forecasts are generated from the updated state and unresolved gaps, then reviewed against realized outcomes to learn which paths converge or diverge.
